Personal administrative assistant

Administrative help, directed by the owner.

PROCURATOR helps the owner review Gmail, prepare Google Docs and organize outputs in a dedicated Google Drive workspace through a private Telegram bot.

This is a private personal tool. There is no public registration or public access to the assistant.

Current capabilities

  • Search and read the connected owner’s Gmail messages to answer requests and prepare summaries.
  • Prepare private plain-text email drafts and save requested iCloud copies in Apple Mail’s Drafts folder. After additional Google authorization, Gmail sends require the owner’s exact-content approval in Telegram.
  • Read the owner’s iCloud inbox after a separate connection is configured; Owner-approved iCloud sending uses a dedicated Google Cloud relay.
  • Search the public web and read pages. A separate cloud browser supports inspected pages, bounded owner-approved routine task steps, and separately approved final submissions. Real-account workflows require site-specific setup and testing.
  • Find Drive files and read Google Docs available to the connected account.
  • Create Google Docs and subfolders, and move individual files within the designated assistant output workspace.

Gmail sending requires the additional send permission and an authenticated owner approval for each message. The assistant keeps an immutable draft snapshot and can save a separate copy in iCloud Drafts. Manual changes in Apple Mail are not automatically imported into the approval snapshot. Phone support includes incoming message-taking and short outgoing calls whose exact destination and brief require authenticated owner approval in Telegram. Calls are limited to one at a time, with a conversation timer below two minutes. Recording is off. Incoming reception admits at most 20 calls per UTC day and three per caller number. Outgoing assignments support regular geographic numbers in the 50 US states and DC; complex menus and long waits are not supported. The public pages do not provide access to the assistant dashboard, messages, documents or account credentials.

Google account access

The owner connects Google through its authorization screen. Requested access includes reading Gmail, sending owner-approved Gmail messages after additional consent, and reading and editing Drive files and Google Docs. The current tool layer limits writes to new documents, subfolders and file moves within the assistant workspace.

Selected Google content can be processed by Anthropic’s API to carry out the owner’s instructions. Replies may be delivered through Telegram and outputs may be saved in Google Drive. Read the privacy notice for data handling and revocation details.

Contact

For questions about this personal app, contact owner@example.com.
